items.description: A complete Langflow implementation that converts natural language queries into SQL, executes them to return JSON results, processes the JSON with LLM analysis, and generates professional PDF reports.

items.name: CityInsights_TelegramBot
items.description: Telegram bot that forwards raw user messages to a Langflow flow and returns a clean, human-readable reply. Users can set area (typed or via Telegram location) and date range (days). Includes slow-flow timeouts, JSON parsing to extract message text, and a simple onboarding UX.

items.name: pi_pilot_langflow
items.description: AI Agent in Langflow with JSON format. This Agent will help you with PI like make an arrangement, and question about PI

items.name: scraper-langflow
items.description: A web scraping chatbot powered by Langflow with a FastAPI backend and an HTML frontend. The chatbot can scrape websites, extract data, and provide responses with both human-readable text and structured JSON content.

items.name: sprint-health-agent
items.description: Dashboard de saúde de sprint — Jira API + Langflow + LLM. Fluxo: Jira → Python (métricas) → LLM (recomendações) → JSON Output.

items.name: Criminal-Law-Agent
items.description: This is a Langflow-based AI agent designed to answer questions related to criminal law. Built using Langflow’s visual interface, the agent uses structured prompts and logic to provide clear, context-aware legal responses. The project is exported in JSON format and can be imported directly into Langflow.

items.name: ai-review-console
items.description: 基于 Langflow 的虚构文档审查控制台：解析、脱敏、规则评分、人工审批、审计与 JSON/HTML/PDF 报告。v0.2 开发快照，非生产服务。

items.name: digital-client-profile
items.description: LangFlow MVP that turns raw client correspondence into a structured JSON profile: strict schema, anti-hallucination insufficient_data rule, custom Python component.

items.name: AI_Test_Result_Analyzer
items.description: AI Test Result Analyzer — a React + Vite app with a backend API that uploads Playwright JSON test results, runs Langflow-based AI analysis, and shows a structured failure report with summary cards and error buckets.

items.name: gbt-flow-canvas
items.description: GBT V8 capability #36/341 · flow_canvas (creation) — 工作流画布（蒸馏自 2026-09-28 主人给的周榜卡 Langflow 155.3k★，只取**可视化架构**，不引拖拽编辑器）：工作流定义 → 图（nodes/edges，数据只走引擎正规出口 `engine.list_workflows()`，R-H99b，不偷读 store/workflows.json）+ dag 运行账 → 运行图（带 done/failed 读数）→ **自包含 SVG 画布页**（零外链零脚本，离线可开可审计）落 outputs/flow-canvas/。**只画不跑**：执行仍走 wf_run/dagrun 的门，产物不掺页面登记面
